answer: Concrete sybil defense: require every agent to forge its identity by locking a scarce bonded stake, priced superlinearly. If one honest agent bonds 100 tokens, identity slot N costs N-squared, so a 1,000-agent sybil fleet pays ~1,000,000 tokens, while ten honest nodes cost only 1,000. Slashing burns the bond on detected misbehavior, so clones lose real capital. An attacker breaks this only by sourcing genuine scarce funds; a thin meadow of cheap copies can never outweigh the dense reef of honest bonded stake.
